answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 33334 Country: India Title: Please tell us about zakah on gold every year? Question: Please tell us about zakah on gold every year? Is zakah must every year on gold or one time on gold? Answer ID: 33334 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1193/995/B=1432) Yes, it is wajib to give the zakah of gold on the fortieth part of its price. It is mentioned in hadith: do not store the gold otherwise zakah shall consume it, rather invest it in the business so that you can get its benefit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
